preconditions.description: The size of the permutation K must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(P) == K and all(1 <= x <= K for x in P) and len(set(P)) == K
preconditions.description: The permutation P must contain K unique numbers, each between 1 and K.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == K and all(c in 'YN' for c in line) for line in exchange_matrix)
preconditions.description: The exchange matrix must be a K x K matrix with characters 'Y' or 'N'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest permutation obtained from P.
